name: Holy Family and Holy Rosary, Oldham

boundary.description: From the M60 Motorway junction 22, E along Hollins Road (A6104) Copster Hill Road, Schofield Street, Ashton Street, Villa Road, Belgrave Road, and by a straight line to King’s Road. SE along King’s Road and by Snipe Clough to and along Oldham – Tameside District boundary (S, then W) to the M60 Motorway and N by the Motorway to junction 22.
